solution.approach: Official Answer: Option B (**₹44,000**).
solution.keyConcept: Direct Simple Interest (SI = P × R × T / 100)

optionTrick.en: Effective interest rate $= 11\% \times 2 = 22\%$. Just take $22\%$ of 2,00,000 $= \mathbf{44,000}$!

solution.en:
Method 1: Standard SI Formula: 1) $P = 2,00,000$, $R = 11\%$, $T = 2$ year(s).
2) $SI = \frac{200000 \times 11 \times 2}{100} = 2000 \times 22 = \mathbf{44,000}$.

Method 2: 1% Base × (R × T) Mental Trick: $1\%$ of Principal $= 2000$. Multiply by $R \times T = 22$: $2000 \times 22 = \mathbf{44,000}$.
solution.hi:

2) $SI = \frac{200000 \times 11 \times 2}{100} = \mathbf{44,000}$ रुपये।

विधि 2: 1% मान × कुल प्रतिशत ट्रिक: मूलधन का $1\% = 2000$। इसे $R \times T = 22$ से गुणा करें $= \mathbf{44,000}$!

question.en: After getting two successive discounts, a shirt with a list price of ₹150 is available at ₹105. If the second discount is 12.5%, then find the first discount.
question.hi: दो क्रमिक छूट मिलने के बाद, ₹150 की अंकित मूल्य वाली एक शर्ट ₹105 पर उपलब्ध है। यदि दूसरी छूट 12.5% है, तो पहली छूट ज्ञात कीजिए।

solution.approach: Official Answer: Option C (**20%**).

title.hi: विधि 1: पीछे से दूसरी छूट हटाएं

steps.en:
Price before 2nd discount (`7/8` of it = `105`) $= 105 \times \frac{8}{7} = 120$.
1st discount on `150` $= \frac{150 - 120}{150} \times 100 = \frac{30}{150} \times 100 = \mathbf{20\%}$.

solution.en:
Method 1: Reverse 12.5% Step: Price before 2nd discount (`7/8` of it = `105`) $= 105 \times \frac{8}{7} = 120$.
1st discount on `150` $= \frac{150 - 120}{150} \times 100 = \frac{30}{150} \times 100 = \mathbf{20\%}$.

Method 2: Parallel Ratio Division (4 sec): Total Ratio `150 : 105 = 10 : 7`. Remove `12.5%` (`8 : 7`) by dividing columns: `(10÷8) : (7÷7) = 5 : 4` ⇒ **20%**!
